name: Toggle single-point / multi-point unlock
steps: Unlock vehicle
Press and hold Smart Key lock and unlock together for about 3 seconds
Hazard flash confirms the mode change
warning: Changes entry behavior only; does not bypass alarm/immobilizer.

name: Start when Smart Key is not detected
steps: Use only when Smart Key Not Found is shown
Place recognized Smart Key at the marked backup position under/outboard of steering column with buttons facing down
Hold brake and press START/STOP
warning: This is for an authorized recognized key; do not use for security bypass.

name: Set maximum powered-tailgate opening height
steps: Open tailgate to desired height and stop it
Keep it stationary at least 3 seconds
Hold tailgate close switch for 10 seconds
Close and reopen to verify
warning: Keep clear of moving tailgate.

name: Restore powered-tailgate position memory
steps: Manually close tailgate
Press a release switch
Allow it to power fully open or to stored height
Press close and allow it to power fully shut
warning: Low voltage or repeated obstruction detection can inhibit powered operation.

name: Move front wipers to service position
steps: Ignition off
Switch ignition on then off
Immediately hold wiper control at single-wipe/lowest position while switching ignition on again
Wipers move to service position; after work switch ignition off to park
warning: Keep Smart Key in vehicle; do not lift blades in normal parked position.

name: Reinitialize one-touch windows after power interruption
steps: Close window fully
Release switch
Lift close switch again and hold for 1 second
Repeat on each window
warning: Keep aperture clear; this restores initialization, not mechanical faults.

name: Recalibrate sunroof after interrupted power
steps: Ignition on, sunroof closed
Press/release front of switch so roof tilts
Press and hold front of switch for 20 seconds
When roof starts moving, keep holding through full open/close cycle
Release only after roof stops
warning: Keep people/objects clear of roof aperture.

name: Raise suspension with Smart Key
steps: Park correctly and apply EPB
Close all doors
Switch hazards on
Hold Smart Key approach-lamps button + unlock together
warning: Verify all people/obstacles are clear under/around vehicle; use extra care with trailer.

name: Lower suspension with Smart Key
steps: Park correctly and apply EPB
Close all doors
Switch hazards on
Hold Smart Key approach-lamps button + tailgate-unlock together
warning: Verify all people/obstacles are clear; vehicle can lower substantially.

name: Lock access height / Crawl mode
steps: At access or normal height and low speed, use suspension lower control as handbook directs
Hold lower command long enough to lock access height
Cancel with raise command or by exceeding system speed threshold
warning: Exact thresholds/indicator behavior must follow the vehicle handbook; do not use at road speed.

name: Store reverse mirror-dip position
steps: Enable mirror dip in Vehicle Setup
Ignition on and select Reverse
Adjust mirrors to desired dipped positions
Select Neutral to store
warning: Menu availability depends on seat/memory specification.

name: Cancel headlamp courtesy delay immediately
steps: With courtesy-delay lamps still on after shutdown, press Smart Key headlamp/approach-lamps button
warning: Behavior depends on lighting configuration.

name: Community forced electronic oil-level readout
evidence: repeated L405 community reports; not confirmed as 13MY owner-manual procedure
steps: Vehicle stationary; pull bonnet release/open bonnet as reported
Ignition on, engine off
Navigate to Oil Level; if it says unavailable, press cruise-control CANCEL twice
warning: Do not use this trick to override sensor DTCs or justify overfilling. Confirm engine-specific checking conditions and investigate implausible readings.

name: Service indicator reset on 13MY
evidence: SSM71851 reproduced from TOPIx by Land Rover community
steps: Do not assume the MY14+ pedal reset works
Use compatible JLR diagnostic service function for genuine 13MY unless verified otherwise by VIN/software
warning: A widely repeated bonnet/door + pedals trick is explicitly documented for MY14 from VIN LG124982 onward, not earlier MY13.

name: Manual service-indicator reset (MY14+ boundary)
applies_to: L405 14MY from VIN LG124982 per SSM71851
steps: Ignition ON, engine off, diagnostic equipment disconnected
Open bonnet and driver door
Fully depress accelerator and brake together and hold about 10 seconds
Wait for service-reset confirmation, then release and cycle ignition
warning: Reset only after service is actually completed; do not apply blindly to 13MY.

name: EPB service mode for rear brake work
applies_to: L405; exact year implementation must be verified
evidence: repeated L405 service references; later JLR docs confirm service-mode concept
steps: Use a compatible diagnostic tool where possible
If using a documented model-specific manual sequence, verify it against current workshop information before retracting actuators
warning: Brake work is safety-critical. Never force powered rear caliper pistons or use an unverified sequence.

name: Connect charger so Battery Monitoring System sees current
scope: owner-safe if using normal smart charger and designated posts
steps: Use the vehicle-designated positive/jump terminal
Connect charger negative to the specified chassis/engine earth rather than bypassing the BMS measurement path
Charge according to charger/JLR guidance
warning: Incorrect connection can make SOC estimation unreliable; high-current work should be left to trained technicians.

name: Register/reset BMS after battery replacement
steps: Fit correct specification battery
Verify BMS clamp/earth connections
Use JLR-capable diagnostic function to reset/recalibrate BMS as applicable
Run battery/charging validation
warning: Do not assume installing a new AGM alone completes the job.

name: Restore missing camera guidance lines
steps: Confirm the camera image itself works
Check camera/view settings for guidance/gridline display before diagnosing hardware
warning: If setting is on and lines remain absent, continue normal diagnostics.

name: First check for Radar Sensor Blocked / C1A67-97
steps: Inspect front number plate size and mounting
Remove stacked/incorrect plate arrangement from radar field only if legal/appropriate
Clean radar-facing area and retest
warning: If correct and clear, sensor alignment/wiring/diagnostics may be needed.

name: Preserve a full scan before clearing codes
evidence: diagnostic best practice reinforced by JLR SSMs
steps: Record all modules, DTCs including suffixes, status and freeze-frame/environment data
Record battery voltage and symptom timing
Only then clear codes if part of a controlled test
Rescan after reproducing symptom
warning: Clearing everything first can erase the chronology that identifies the upstream fault.

name: Safe baseline before non-security CCF personalization
steps: Export/screenshot full original CCF/configuration before changes
Use stabilized battery support
Change one benign owner-personalization item at a time
Cycle vehicle and full-scan after each change
Keep rollback copy
warning: Do not experiment with immobilizer/keys, SRS, ABS/brakes, steering, powertrain/emissions, odometer/VIN or unsupported hardware flags. Feature availability is hardware/calibration dependent.

name: Open GEN2.1 touchscreen diagnostic/engineering screen for read-only checks
applies_to: GEN2.1-era L405 where this interface is present; verify MY/software
evidence: later L405 workshop documentation + L405/L494 owner reports
confidence: medium-high for GEN2.1 family, exact entry path can vary
steps: With vehicle safely stationary, first try holding the on-screen Valet soft key continuously for roughly 20 seconds to expose engineering mode
On workshop-documented diagnostic variants, another entry path is hold top-centre of touchscreen about 5 seconds, then top-left about 5 seconds, then enter diagnostic PIN 753
Use read-only pages such as battery voltage, vehicle signals, hard-key/soft-key tests, MOST status, video inputs or colour-bar/self-test where present
Photograph values/screens before exiting
warning: Do not alter car configuration, security, speed-lock, SRS, brake, steering, immobilizer, VIN/odometer or unsupported settings. Menu availability and layout differ by software/model year; if the path does not work, stop rather than improvising.

name: Use recirculation flap to expose cabin/pollen-filter access
applies_to: L405 HVAC layout where filter is behind glovebox
steps: Lower the glovebox using its service/access stops
With HVAC powered, select recirculation so the recirculation flap lifts away from the filter housing
Remove the filter tray/cover without forcing the flap
Refit correctly and return recirculation to normal
warning: Do not force the flap by hand; broken pivots/actuator damage are reported and can turn a filter change into major HVAC-housing work.
